description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

J&T is seeking a Software Engineer 1 to design, develop, test, and enhance complex software systems in Fort Meade. The role contributes across the software development lifecycle, including analytics, algorithms, database interfaces, system integration, testing, and technical documentation.
Software Engineer analyzing requirements and designing, implementing, and testing applications, algorithms, and database interfaces

Responsibilities:
• Analyze user needs and operational requirements to derive comprehensive software design and performance specifications
• Design, code, and test new software features and modify existing applications to adapt to new hardware or operating environments
• Develop, optimize, and implement algorithms to meet or exceed system performance and functional criteria
• Create and execute test procedures for software components, resolve defect reports, and document test outcomes
• Design and implement complex database interfaces, queries, and data extraction routines for varied repositories
• Use scientific analysis and mathematical modeling to predict and measure design outcomes and system behavior
• Collaborate with systems engineers, end users, and technical leads to evaluate data usage, workflow efficiency, and software reuse opportunities
• Author and review detailed technical documentation and recommend continuous improvements to development process standards

Requirements:
• Active TS/SCI with a current Polygraph
• Demonstrated experience in full-lifecycle software development, algorithm implementation, and application debugging
• Experience integrating software solutions into new or modified platforms, operating environments, and database architectures
• Proven ability to author test procedures, document test results, and draft clear software design specifications

Preferred:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline
• at least 7 years of software engineering experience on programs of similar scope and complexity
• 11 years of relevant software engineering experience without a degree (4 additional years substituting for the degree)
• Hands-on experience developing processing-intensive data analytics and manipulating extremely large datasets
• Prior experience leading small technical tasks or sprint teams within structured development methodologies
